- [Reset and account recovery](#reset-and-account-recovery)

## Using SoAI

### Chat [page: chat]

Use Chat to talk to a model, compare answers, work with files, [speak instead of type](#voice-dictation-and-speech), or ask an agent to use tools. SoAI saves each transcript with the models, mode, prompts, generation settings, workspace folder, tools, and Knowledge used in that conversation. Knowledge is an indexed document collection that the assistant can search. Open the conversation later and those settings return with it. See [Conversation context](#conversation-context-compaction-and-history) for what SoAI stores, sends to the model, and compacts as the transcript grows.

#### Before Chat appears

On a fresh installation with no selectable conversation model, SoAI leaves **Chat** and **Automation** out of the main sidebar.

1. In the SoAI WebUI, open **Models** and select **Add model**.
2. Use **Download model** for a local chat model. If it needs a local backend first, follow [Install and manage plugins](#install-and-manage-plugins). For a remote model, select **Add provider** and use the bundled External plugin.

Chat appears after the catalog contains a selectable conversation model, meaning the model is loaded or available and is not embedding-only. A provider configuration alone does not count; discovery must add one of its models to the catalog. See [Models catalog](#models-catalog) for model discovery, downloads, and availability.

**An embedding-only model does not unlock Chat because it cannot answer conversation prompts.** It can still supply the vectors used by Knowledge. After this first-run gate opens, that browser remembers it; Chat can remain in the sidebar if the model later becomes unavailable, but you must select or restore a selectable conversation model before you can send a message.

#### Conditional controls

Chat shows actions when they apply. Visibility and availability depend on the model, conversation state, screen width, browser support, account access, and Appearance settings.

| Control | When it appears or becomes available |
| --- | --- |
| Approval, question, and secret panels | These appear only when an agent has paused for that specific response. |
| Compact and Export conversation | These actions require at least one message. They are unavailable while a response or agent turn is running. |
| Controls in automation or messaging conversations | The Automation or Messaging configuration that created the conversation can hide or lock its execution settings. Change them at the source rather than in Chat. |
| Header and composer actions | On a narrow screen, actions such as Favorite, Tools, the plan toggle, and some composer controls move under **More actions** or into the compact header. |
| Message actions | Hover over a message or focus it with the keyboard. The message role and current state decide whether actions such as Edit, Resend message, Regenerate, Speak, or Message info apply. History-changing actions stay unavailable during a turn. |
| Model selector in the header | The sidebar model selector is the main control while the sidebar is open. The header selector appears when the sidebar is closed or Chat is in a detached window. |
| Previous variant and Next variant | These appear only on a comparison turn that has more than one model reply. |
| Saved prompts, character map, token counter, voice, attachments, and camera | Turn each action on under **Chat configuration** > **Appearance** > **Input actions**. The Upload and Scan panes follow the attachment and camera choices. Dictation can remain disabled when the page or browser cannot record audio or permission is missing. Voice Call also requires a selected conversation model. Scan needs browser camera support and permission. |
| Toggle plan bar and Toggle todo bar | These appear after the current conversation has a plan or todo list. |

#### Page layout

| Area | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| Conversation sidebar | Select a model, start a conversation, search conversations, move favorites to the top, open a conversation, and use selection mode for batch actions. |
| Conversation header | Rename the conversation, change mode, compact context, export, open Chat configuration, mark the conversation as a favorite, manage tools, show a plan or todo list, and start another conversation. |
| Timeline | Read messages, reasoning and activity states, tool calls, plans, todos, attachments, approval requests, and errors. Older or newer windows of a long transcript load as you move through it. |
| Interaction previews | Review queued prompts, approve tools, answer agent questions, provide requested secrets, monitor voice recording, and inspect attachments before sending. |
| Composer | Write a prompt, attach context, use saved prompts, dictate, start a voice call, inspect token use, and send, stop, steer, or queue input. |

#### Start a conversation

1. Select **New chat** in the conversation sidebar, or **New conversation** in the header.
2. Select the current model name at the top of the sidebar, then choose an available model. You can also use the model selector in the header or empty conversation. Search narrows the list, and availability labels show which models are ready to use.
3. Select the mode label in the header and choose **Chat**, **Plan**, or **Execute**.
4. Write a message. Add files or configure tools and Knowledge if you need them, then send it.

##### Defaults and titles

A new conversation begins with an empty transcript. When **Use last settings for new chats** is enabled, it starts with your last model, tools, and Knowledge settings. Otherwise it uses the configured defaults. Change this preference under **Chat configuration** > **General**, then select **Save**. SoAI saves a new conversation when you first send or use a feature that needs a saved chat.

Turn on **Auto-rename conversations** under **Chat configuration** > **Appearance** if you want SoAI to create a short title after the first primary-model reply. SoAI leaves a title alone after you edit it. Select the title in the header to rename the open conversation yourself.

##### Model requirements

Select an available model before sending. If a saved model disappears from the catalog, SoAI keeps its name visible and marks it **(missing)**; choose another model or fix that backend before you continue. **Tools need a model with tool-calling support.** Image input also needs a model and backend that accept images. See [Models catalog](#models-catalog) for model setup and capability details.

#### Choose the conversation mode

Select the current **Chat**, **Plan**, or **Execute** label in the header to choose how the assistant should work. The same control appears in an empty conversation. You can also press `Shift`+`Tab` to cycle through the modes. Each mode has its own tool selection.

| Mode | Use it for | Tool behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chat | Questions, writing, analysis, and ordinary conversation. | Tools are optional. When you turn them on, SoAI uses the conversation's Chat tool selection. |
| Plan | Explore a task, clarify requirements, and write a plan without making changes. | Plan keeps tools enabled but blocks destructive tools and tools without enough safety information. |
| Execute | Carrying out a multi-step task with progress tracking and tool use. | Execute keeps tools enabled and uses the Execute tool selection. Those tools can change files, run commands, control a browser, or affect external services. |

**Plan and Execute need a model with tool-calling support and at least one tool selected for that mode.** Changing the mode cannot grant access to disabled tools or tools outside your account permissions. Finish or stop the current turn before changing its mode or tools.

#### Use one model or compare several

Open the model selector and select the primary model. To compare answers, select **Compare models**, then choose models in the slots labeled **Model 2** through **Model 5**. You can use one primary model and up to four comparison models in the same turn. Change or remove a slot while the conversation is idle.

SoAI sends the prompt to every selected model and groups the replies into one comparison turn. Use **Previous variant** and **Next variant** to read each reply. Every variant shares the earlier transcript and stays in the same conversation. The carousel changes the visible reply. **Later prompts use the primary model's reply as conversation history, even when another variant remains visible.**

You cannot steer a comparison because several models are answering. If SoAI can accept another prompt, the composer shows **Queue**; otherwise wait or select **Stop**.

#### Write, send, steer, and queue prompts

The composer accepts multiline text and direct attachments. On an empty conversation, suggestion cards can insert a starting prompt. Select **Saved prompts** beside the composer to insert an entry from your prompt library. Select **Manage prompts** in that picker to create or edit entries on the Prompts page. Select **Open character map**, choose one or more characters, then select **Insert** when you need characters that are inconvenient to type. If either action is missing, turn it on under **Chat configuration** > **Appearance** > **Input actions**, then select **Save**.

SoAI saves the composer text and ready direct attachments as a draft for that conversation. Switch conversations or reload the page and the draft returns. Drafts also sync between signed-in browsers. If another browser changes the same draft while you are typing, SoAI keeps your local text and shows a conflict instead of replacing it.

The primary composer action changes with the state of the current turn:

- **Send** starts a new turn when the conversation is idle.
- **Stop** ends the active response or agent turn when the composer is empty.
- **Steer** gives new text and ready attachments to an agent turn that can accept guidance without waiting for the turn to finish.
- **Queue** stores the text and ready attachments for the next available turn. Pending queue items appear above the composer and can be cancelled before they start.

The button label tells you what will happen. An approval, agent question, secret request, comparison, or existing queue item can limit the next action. New text will steer only when the button says **Steer**.

##### Keyboard controls

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl`+`Enter` or `Cmd`+`Enter` | Send when idle, stop when running, or save an active message edit. |
| `Shift`+`Enter` | Insert a new line. |
| `Tab` | Send when idle. During an active turn that accepts more input, queue the composer text and attachments. |
| `Shift`+`Tab` | Cycle Chat, Plan, and Execute mode. |
| `Esc` | Stop an active turn, cancel an agent question, or exit conversation selection mode. |
| `ArrowUp` at the start of the composer | Move backward through your saved prompt history. |
| `ArrowDown` at the end of the composer | Move forward through your saved prompt history. |

#### Attach files, folders, and media

**Add attachments** opens Upload, Scan, Workspace, SoAI link, and Knowledge. One message can mix files from several of these sources. Direct files must finish processing before you send; linked workspace items remain verified references, while Knowledge builds a searchable conversation collection.

See [Attachments and file context](#attachments-and-file-context) for every WebUI attachment path, including folder uploads, Global Search and Files links, SoAI links pasted into the composer, images, audio, video, document parsing, limits, and conditional controls.

#### Build indexed Knowledge for a conversation

Use Knowledge for documents that the assistant should search across several prompts. Knowledge needs an embedding-capable model to index and search the collection, plus a conversation model with tool-calling support to use the results while answering. One model can fill both roles when it supports both capabilities.

Your account needs **RAG access** ([`RAG_USE`](#acl-RAG_USE)) to use Knowledge. Importing from Workspace also needs **Files reading** ([`FILE_EXPLORER_READ`](#acl-FILE_EXPLORER_READ)). The default policy grants both actions to Administrator and Standard user accounts. An Administrator with **ACL administration** ([`ACL_ADMIN`](#acl-ACL_ADMIN)) selects the **Settings** button at the right of the header, chooses **Settings**, then opens **ACL** to change them.

##### Prepare an embedding model

**Auto (embedding)** chooses from embedding models already available to SoAI. It does not download a model or add embedding support to a chat model. Prepare a local or remote embedding model before you add documents.

| Source | WebUI setup |
| --- | --- |
| Local [Llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) Embeddings plugin | Open **Plugins**, find **[Llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) Embeddings**, and select **Install backend** if its backend is not installed. Choose a backend variant if SoAI asks, then select **Start installation**. Next, open **Models**, select **Add model** > **Download model**, choose **[Llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) Embeddings** as the plugin, and use **Model search** to find a GGUF embedding model. Choose a model and quantization, then select **Download model**. The [Bundled plugins reference](#bundled-plugins-reference) describes the dedicated local Embedding runtime. |
| Remote provider through External | Open **Models**, select **Add model** > **Add provider**, choose **External**, and enter the provider name, OpenAI-compatible API URL, API key, and optional **Models filter**. Leave the filter blank or include the embedding model's ID or a matching pattern; an unmatched filter keeps that model out of SoAI's catalog. The API URL is the provider's OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as `https://api.example.com/v1`, rather than a direct `/models` or `/embeddings` URL. Select **Add provider**. Choose a model that the provider documents as embedding-capable; the provider must support the OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint. No local backend installation is needed for External. |

After the download or provider discovery finishes and SoAI refreshes the model catalog, return to **Chat configuration** > **Knowledge**. Check that the model appears under **Embedding model**. If the list says **No embedding models available**, the current catalog has no available model marked with embedding support. Select the model directly, or use **Auto (embedding)** once at least one suitable model is listed.

##### Add and index documents

Add and manage the collection from **Add attachments** > **Knowledge**:

1. Select **Upload file**, **Upload folder**, or **Load from Workspace**.
2. Follow the indexing status. A document can move through queued, parsing, chunking, and embedding before it is ready. SoAI marks unreadable files and errors in the same list.
3. After a document finishes processing, select **Delete** beside it to remove it from this conversation's collection.
4. Select **Reindex** after changing the embedding model or chunking settings.

Change retrieval settings under **Chat configuration** > **Knowledge**. Turn on **Enable RAG**, select an embedding model or **Auto (embedding)**, choose the retrieval and chunking values, then select **Save**. These settings belong to the open conversation.

When RAG is enabled, the collection has a document, the Knowledge tools are available, and the conversation model supports tool calling, SoAI keeps those tools enabled for the conversation. The ordinary tool toggle cannot remove them until you disable indexed Knowledge. **Without tool-calling support, the conversation model cannot search or list the collection even when its documents are ready.**

| Knowledge control | Available values | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chunk overlap | 0 to 500 | Repeats content between adjacent chunks, in the unit the chosen strategy counts. Paragraph ignores it. For token based and fixed size, overlap must be smaller than chunk size. |
| Chunk size | 100 to 4,000 | Sets the target chunk size. Token based counts tokens. Fixed size, paragraph, and semantic count characters. |
| Chunking strategy | Token based, fixed size, paragraph, semantic | Splits a document before embedding, which decides what a search can return. |
| Retrieval strategy | Similarity, MMR, Hybrid | Ranks the passages a search returns. |
| Similarity threshold | 0 to 1 | Filters weak matches. |
| Top K | 1 to 50 | Limits how many chunks a search can return. |

Direct Upload attachments belong to one message, while Knowledge documents belong to the conversation's indexed collection. Use Upload when a file belongs with the current prompt, and use Knowledge when you want the assistant to search a collection across later prompts. The values above are what this form accepts; [Knowledge and document collections (RAG)](#knowledge-and-document-collections-rag) covers which chunking and retrieval strategy suits a source, what the indexing stages mean, and when a collection has to be reindexed.

#### Configure and approve tools

Use the **Tools** control in the header to turn tools on or off for a Chat conversation. Plan and Execute keep tools on. To choose specific tools, open **Chat configuration** > **Tools**, search the list, expand a server, and select tools for **Chat mode**, **Plan mode**, or **Execute mode**. Select **Save** when you finish.

Your account needs **MCP usage** ([`MCP_USE`](#acl-MCP_USE)) to open the tool picker. The default policy grants this action to Administrator and Standard user accounts. An Administrator with **ACL administration** ([`ACL_ADMIN`](#acl-ACL_ADMIN)) selects the **Settings** button at the right of the header, chooses **Settings**, then opens **ACL** to change it.

SoAI locks the Tools control during an active turn. Indexed Knowledge also keeps its required tools on; turn off **Enable RAG** under **Chat configuration** > **Knowledge** before you try to disable them.

To edit the starting lists for later conversations, select **Select** under **Default tools (new chats)**. This dialog is another view of the staged tool lists for the open conversation, so its changes also appear in the main tool picker. Close the dialog, review the selections, and select **Save** to update both the open conversation and your defaults for later chats.

The list contains the built-in tools and any tools from remote MCP servers available to your account. Chat can use web search, browser control, file editing, shell commands, memory, or image generation only when the matching tool appears in the list and you select it for the current mode. See [Agent tools overview](#agent-tools-overview) and [MCP overview](#mcp-overview) for the catalogs and server setup.

##### Approval prompts

Turn on **Require tool approval** under **Chat configuration** > **Tools** to pause before a destructive tool, a tool flagged as requiring approval, or a tool with missing or invalid destructive metadata. The approval panel names the tool and shows its proposed input. Select **Approve** or **Deny**.

Select **Remember for this tool** when you trust later calls covered by the same saved permission. **For most tools, that permission applies by tool name across your account's conversations, regardless of the arguments in a later call.** Browser credential autofill is the exception: SoAI limits permission to the destination site. If it cannot determine the site, approve without Remember to allow the current call once.

Plan mode still blocks destructive tools and tools with missing or invalid destructive metadata. An Administrator selects the **Settings** button at the right of the header, chooses **Settings**, then opens **Reset > Tool approvals** to clear saved approvals.

##### Interactive agent checkpoints

Agent turns can pause for three user-facing interactions:

- **Tool approval** asks whether a proposed call may run.
- **Question** asks for one or more answers needed to continue the task.
- **Secret request** asks for a credential and can offer to save it in the Secrets Vault with a label.

Answer the panel above the composer to continue. If you cancel it or let it expire, SoAI marks that interaction as cancelled, timed out, or failed. **The agent does not receive a successful tool result.**

#### Follow plans, todos, tools, and subagents

Plan and Execute turns can expose a plan or todo panel above the timeline. After the turn creates one, the matching **Toggle plan bar** or **Toggle todo bar** control appears in the header. Use it to show or hide the panel. The same progress updates remain in the transcript.

Tool activity appears inside the assistant turn. A row can show the tool name, state, input, result, duration, URL, code diff, media preview, or error. Expand a row for details. Select **View full output** when a long result offers it. A running shell command has its own **Stop command** action.

When an agent delegates work, subagent activity appears in the same timeline with its status, timing, and nested activity. Tool results stay with the assistant turn that produced them.

#### Read and act on messages

Turn **Render rich text (Markdown)** on or off under **Chat configuration** > **Appearance**. Rich text gives code blocks a copy action and makes Markdown table headers sortable. Plain-text mode shows the original message text. If Markdown rendering fails, SoAI keeps the message and shows safe plain text.

Turn on **Inline multimedia previews** in the same tab to show supported media links and file references inside the timeline. Use **Show activities** to expand or collapse thinking, processing, tool use, and waiting states. Hover over a message, or focus it with the keyboard, to show the actions that apply to it.

| Message action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Copy | Copies the message content. Code blocks also have a dedicated copy control. |
| Delete | Replaces the message with a temporary deleted placeholder. Choose **Undo** during the short undo window, or select **Delete** again to commit before the timer expires. |
| Edit | Replaces a user message, removes every later message, and requests a fresh reply from that point. Direct attachments on the edited message can also be removed before saving. |
| Message info | Shows available model, timestamp, prompt and completion tokens, total tokens, generation speed, latency, finish reason, and compaction statistics. |
| Regenerate | Replaces an assistant reply and removes messages that followed that reply. |
| Resend message | Resubmits a selected user message and removes every later message before generating the new continuation. |
| Speak | Reads an assistant message using the selected or automatic text-to-speech model. |

**Edit, resend, and regenerate rewrite the continuation of the transcript.** Export or clone the conversation first if you need to preserve the later turns. SoAI disables history-changing message actions while the conversation runs.

#### Use the token counter and compact context

Open **Chat configuration** > **Appearance** > **Input actions**, turn on **Token counter**, and select **Save**. The counter beside the composer shows estimated or measured prompt use and the model's context window when SoAI knows it. Select the counter to switch between token use and generation speed. Its color changes as the prompt approaches the limit. Prompt use includes the enabled [SoAI system prompt](#soai-system-prompt) and its runtime context.

##### Context compaction

Before an agent request, SoAI may compact older history when the full prompt no longer fits the available prompt budget. To start compaction yourself, wait until the conversation has at least one message and is idle, then select **Compact** in the header. SoAI uses the selected conversation model, summarizes older context, and adds a visible boundary to the transcript. Later turns use that summary in place of the earlier detail.

Automatic compaction also applies to messaging conversations. It lets a conversation continue without a fixed message-count limit. The server may replace older details with a summary instead of sending them to the model word for word. Each messaging account can use a different context length and therefore have its own effective compaction limit. Select the **Settings** button at the right of the header, choose **Settings**, select **Messaging**, then use **Edit** for the account. Under **Chat execution**, select **Edit parameters** and set **Context length (tokens)** under **Model settings**. Clear it to use the selected model's default. A lower value gives that account a smaller context budget, so it compacts sooner. This can help when a smaller model gives worse answers as its prompt grows, and it does not change the context length of other messaging accounts.

Expand the boundary to read its summary, injected prompt, and compaction details. While the conversation is idle, select **Regenerate** to create the manual boundary again or select **Remove boundary**. **Removing it returns the earlier transcript to normal context, so check the token counter before continuing.**

#### Use dictation, speech, and voice calls

Select **Start voice recording**, speak, then select **Stop recording**. SoAI transcribes the recording with the selected or automatic speech-to-text model and adds the text to the composer. Review it before sending. **Starting dictation ends an active voice call.**

##### Voice call

Select **Start voice call** for hands-free chat. Voice Call listens until you stop speaking, sends the transcription, waits for the model, and reads the answer aloud. If you speak while the assistant is answering, SoAI stops that speech and response so your new utterance can take over. Use **Pause voice call**, **Resume voice call**, or **End voice call** in the call dialog. Switching conversations ends the call.

##### Voice requirements

- Open Chat through HTTPS or `localhost` so the browser can grant microphone access.
- Allow microphone permission and use a browser with media recording support.
- Select a conversation model before starting Voice Call.

Choose automatic or specific STT and TTS models under **Chat configuration** > **Voice**. If the composer actions are missing, turn on **Voice** and **Voice call** under **Chat configuration** > **Appearance** > **Input actions**. The **Speak** message action uses the same TTS selection.

#### Organize conversations

The sidebar search field matches conversation titles and message text that the browser has loaded. Select **Show favorites at top** to bring marked conversations to the top of the list. To rename the open conversation, select its title in the header. For a sidebar conversation, select **Edit** on its row to change the color, rename it, archive it, export it, or change its favorite status. Select **Delete** on the row to remove the conversation.

To archive, clone, or delete several conversations, expand the toolbar at the bottom of the sidebar, select **Select conversations**, mark the rows, then choose **Archive selected**, **Clone selected**, or **Delete selected**. You can select one conversation and use **Clone selected** when you need a single copy.

##### What a clone contains

A clone gets its own transcript and settings, including the assistant and tool activity already recorded. SoAI copies ready direct-file attachments. **It does not copy the indexed Knowledge collection, so Knowledge attachment cards in the cloned transcript show as unavailable.** To use those documents in the clone, open it and add or import them again under **Add attachments** > **Knowledge**. Later messages in the two conversations are independent. Finish or stop running and queued work before cloning or deleting a conversation.

##### Archive and sidebar filters

Archive hides a conversation from the active list without deleting its transcript. Expand the sidebar toolbar and select **Archived conversations** to search, open, unarchive, rename, recolor, favorite, or delete archived items.

Automation runs and messaging-account conversations can also appear in the sidebar. Their execution settings belong to the Automation or Messaging configuration that created them, so Chat hides or locks those controls. To remove either type from the sidebar, open **Chat configuration** > **Appearance**, turn on **Hide automation runs** or **Hide messaging conversations**, then select **Save**. See [Connect messaging apps to SoAI](#connect-messaging-apps-to-soai) to add or manage a messaging account.

A message sent from Chat while a messaging conversation is open, and the immediate reply, stay in Chat. They are not copied to the messaging app, but both remain in the transcript and can affect the model's later replies. To change that conversation's model, agent mode, workspace, display names, parameters, MCP tools, account credentials, or sender policy, select the **Settings** button at the right of the header, choose **Settings**, select **Messaging**, and use **Edit** for the account.

Files sent from [Discord](https://discord.com/), [Telegram](https://telegram.org/), or [WhatsApp](https://www.whatsapp.com/) appear with the provider message in this conversation. SoAI processes them as conversation attachments before the model answers. See [Attachments and file context](#attachments-and-file-context) for how documents and media become model context.

You can attach files to a message that you send from Chat in a messaging conversation. That message, its files, and SoAI's immediate reply stay in SoAI. **They can affect later model replies but are not forwarded to the messaging app.**

#### Choose where persistent context belongs

Chat has several ways to keep context. **Pick the narrowest scope that matches the work so unrelated conversations do not receive unnecessary instructions or data.**

| Context | Scope | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Message text or direct attachment | One message in one conversation | Write it in the composer or use **Add attachments** for a question, instruction, image, or file needed at that point in the transcript. |
| Conversation system prompt | Model requests in the conversation | Set behavior, role, format, or standing instructions under **Chat configuration** > **Parameters** > **System prompt**. **Lock system prompt** applies the same prompt to new messages and conversations until you unlock it. |
| Knowledge | Indexed documents for one conversation | Build a collection that the assistant should search across repeated questions under **Add attachments** > **Knowledge**. |
| Memory and profile | Your user account across chats | Store preferences, goals, relationships, and recurring personal context under **Chat configuration** > **Memory** > **Open profile form**. |
| Workspace folder | File base for one conversation | Select the folder that file and tool workflows should use under **Chat configuration** > **Files** > **Change folder**. |

#### Configure Chat

Select **Chat configuration** in the header, choose a tab, make your changes, then select **Save**. The table below separates settings that belong to the open conversation from those that apply to your WebUI or to new chats.

| Tab | Controls | Main scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Appearance | Text zoom, widescreen layout, Markdown rendering, inline multimedia previews, automatic titles, activity display, sidebar visibility filters, completion and error notifications, microphone sounds, composer action visibility, and **Auxiliary mobile input action**, which keeps one extra action beside Send on compact layouts. | WebUI preferences. |
| Files | Select **Change folder** to override the workspace folder for this conversation, or **Inherit default** to use your default folder. SoAI removes an override if a later default folder change places it outside your allowed workspace. | Current conversation. |
| General | Primary and comparison models, **Hide model id**, **Your name**, **Your photo**, **Model name**, **Model photo**, **Export to PDF**, and **Use last settings for new chats**. | Conversation identity plus user defaults and export preference. |
| Knowledge | RAG enablement, embedding model, retrieval strategy, Top K, similarity threshold, and chunking controls. Use **Add attachments** > **Knowledge** for documents and reindexing. | Current conversation. |
| Memory | Select **Refresh memory** to reload saved memories or **Open profile form** to edit the personal context SoAI can use across your chats. | User memory shared across chats. |
| Parameters | **System prompt**, **Lock system prompt**, [**SoAI system prompt**](#soai-system-prompt), **Context length (tokens)**, **Reasoning effort**, **Max completion tokens**, **Agent max iterations**, temperature, Top P, frequency and presence penalties, **Stop sequences**, **Top log probabilities**, and **Service tier**. Reasoning effort, Max completion tokens, Top P, both penalties, Stop sequences, and Top log probabilities have a **Send this parameter to the model** switch. | Current conversation, model requests, and the user's prompt-lock preference. |
| Presets | Search, create, apply, rename, replace, and delete reusable configuration presets. A preset records only the sections you select. Parameter reset leaves model, identity, Files, Knowledge, and Tools unchanged. | User preset library. |
| Tools | Tool enablement, approval requirement, defaults for new chats, server groups, tool search, and separate Chat, Plan, and Execute selections. | Current conversation plus user defaults for new chats. |
| Voice | Automatic or specific text-to-speech and speech-to-text models. | User voice preference. |

After you change models, SoAI may mark a saved option such as **Reasoning effort** as unsupported. Choose a value supported by the new model before turning on **Send this parameter to the model** for that option. Automation and messaging conversations can lock settings controlled by their source configuration.

Saved prompts and configuration presets solve different problems. A saved prompt inserts reusable text into the composer. Applying a preset copies its selected sections into the Chat configuration dialog; review them and select **Save**. Arrow-key prompt history contains text you submitted before and remains separate from both.

#### Export a conversation

1. Wait until the conversation has at least one message and its current response has finished.
2. Open **Chat configuration** > **General**. Turn **Export to PDF** on for PDF or off for JSON, then select **Save**.
3. Select **Export conversation** in the header or under **More actions**.

PDF export creates a styled transcript with comparison turns, tool activity, attachments, and compaction boundaries. JSON downloads the structured conversation with its model and parameter settings.

If PDF creation fails after SoAI has prepared the conversation, SoAI reports the failure and downloads the JSON version. Export stays unavailable during a response so the download does not omit a reply that is still arriving.

#### Leave, return, and work in another window

**Switching conversations or leaving Chat does not stop work that SoAI has accepted.** The sidebar marks conversations that are running or need your attention, and the timeline catches up when you return. Turn completion and error notifications on under **Chat configuration** > **Appearance**. Select **Stop** before leaving when you want to end the work.

After a connection returns, SoAI reloads drafts, queued prompts, messages, tool activity, and attention notices. The same items appear in another signed-in browser, so a prompt queued in one browser can appear in another. You can cancel a pending queue item. Once it starts, use **Stop**.

##### Detached Chat

Select **Open in new window** in the top bar to detach Chat. SoAI saves the current draft and opens the selected conversation in a separate window. The detached window uses the same signed-in session and conversations.

#### Common blocked states

| What you see | What it means | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A draft conflict appears | The same conversation draft changed in another client. | Review the text and attachments SoAI kept in this browser, then continue editing or send that version. |
| A stream error appears in the timeline | The model, backend, connection, tool sequence, or system resource failed. A server error can include a reference ID. | Check that the selected model is available and that its backend is running, then resend the message. Follow any action shown with the error. Before resending a prompt that used tools, inspect the tool activity: a tool may have completed even though the stream ended with an error. Repeat it only when the action is safe to run twice. If the problem continues, give the reference ID to an administrator. |
| Clone or delete fails because the conversation is active | The conversation still has queued or running work that must reach a final state first. | Resolve interactions, cancel pending queue items, and stop or wait for active work. |
| Context occupancy is near the model limit | The transcript, prompt, attachments, and tool history are consuming most of the context window. | Compact the conversation while idle, reduce input, or choose a model with a suitable context window. |
| Export or message history actions are unavailable | A response or agent turn is still running. | Wait for it to finish or select **Stop**, then try the action again. |
| Send is unavailable | You have not selected an available model, the composer is empty, or an attachment is not ready. | Select an available model, add input, and wait for processing or remove the failed attachment. |
| Tool or mode controls are locked | The conversation is running, Plan or Execute requires tools, or another feature manages required tools. | Finish or stop the turn. To turn tools off, switch to Chat mode and disable indexed Knowledge first if it is keeping the required Knowledge tools enabled. |
| Voice controls are disabled | The page is not in a secure context, the browser lacks media support, permission was denied, or no model is selected. | Use HTTPS or `localhost`, allow microphone access, check the input device, and select a model. |

### Agent mode, tool approvals, and checkpoints [page: agent-mode-tool-approvals-and-checkpoints]

Chat, Plan, and Execute use the same conversation but apply different tool policies. In the SoAI WebUI, open **Chat** from the sidebar, start or select a conversation, then select the current mode in the conversation header. You can also press `Shift`+`Tab` to cycle modes. Finish or stop the active turn before changing its mode or tool selection.

#### Choose modes and tools

| Mode | Use it for | Tool behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Chat** | Questions, writing, analysis, and ordinary conversation. | Tools are optional and use the Chat selection. |
| **Plan** | Explore a task, clarify requirements, and write a plan without making changes. | Tools stay enabled, but destructive tools and tools without enough safety metadata are blocked. |
| **Execute** | Carry out a multi-step task with progress tracking. | Tools stay enabled and use the Execute selection. Selected tools can change files, run commands, control a browser, or affect an external service. |

**Plan and Execute require a model with tool-calling support and at least one selected tool for that mode.** A mode cannot grant a permission the account lacks or enable a feature that runtime policy has disabled.

##### Select tools by mode

In Chat mode, use **Tools** in the header to turn tool use on or off. Open **Chat configuration > Tools** to search tools, expand a server, and make separate selections for **Chat mode**, **Plan mode**, and **Execute mode**. Select **Save**. The picker includes built-in tools and available tools from connected MCP servers.

Tool selection requires **MCP usage** ([`MCP_USE`](#acl-MCP_USE)). The header control is locked during a turn. Indexed Knowledge also keeps its required retrieval tools enabled; disable **Enable RAG** under **Chat configuration > Knowledge** before trying to turn those tools off.

**Default tools (new chats)** edits the staged tool lists for the open conversation and the defaults later chats inherit. Close that picker, review the main selections, and select **Save** to commit both.

#### Approvals and checkpoints

Turn on **Require tool approval** under **Chat configuration > Tools**. SoAI pauses before a destructive tool, a tool marked as requiring approval, or a tool whose destructive metadata is missing or invalid. The panel names the tool and shows its proposed input. Select **Approve** or **Deny**.

**Remember for this tool** stores an account-level permission for later calls covered by the same rule. For most tools, that permission follows the tool name and does not narrow itself to the current arguments. Browser credential autofill is narrower: its remembered permission is limited to the destination site. If SoAI cannot determine that site, approve the current call without remembering it.

**Plan mode continues to block destructive or insufficiently described tools even when an approval was remembered.** To clear saved permissions, an Administrator opens the **Settings** button at the right of the header, then **Settings > Reset > Tool approvals**.

##### Respond to agent checkpoints

An agent turn can pause for one of three user responses:

- **Tool approval** asks whether a proposed call may run.
- **Question** requests one or more answers needed to continue.
- **Secret request** requests a credential and can offer to save it in the Secrets Vault with a label.

Answer the panel above the composer. Cancelling it or allowing it to expire produces a cancelled, timed-out, or failed interaction. **The agent does not receive a fabricated successful tool result.**

#### Monitor and control an agent turn

Plan and Execute can add a plan or todo panel above the timeline. After one exists, use **Toggle plan bar** or **Toggle todo bar** in the header to show or hide it. The progress events remain in the transcript.

Tool rows can show state, input, result, duration, URL, code changes, media, or an error. Expand a row for detail and use **View full output** when it is available. A running shell action has its own **Stop command**. If an agent delegates work, subagent status, timing, and nested activity appear in the same assistant turn.

##### Stop, steer, or queue

During a turn, an empty composer can show **Stop**. When the current agent can accept guidance, text and ready attachments change the action to **Steer**. Otherwise SoAI can offer **Queue** for a later turn. A queued item can be cancelled until it starts. An approval, question, secret request, comparison turn, or existing queue item can restrict the next action; rely on the current button label.

### Conversation context, compaction, and history [page: conversation-context-compaction-and-history]

A saved conversation keeps its transcript, models, mode, prompts, generation settings, workspace folder, tool selections, and Knowledge settings. **Older messages remain visible even when they no longer fit in a model request.** This page separates transcript history from the narrower context SoAI sends to a model.

In the SoAI WebUI, open **Chat** from the sidebar and select the conversation before using the header, composer, or **Chat configuration** paths below.

#### Context limits and compaction

| Context | Scope | Set it here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Message text or direct attachment | One message in one conversation | Composer and **Add attachments** |
| Conversation system prompt | Model requests in the conversation | **Chat configuration > Parameters > System prompt** |
| [SoAI system prompt](#soai-system-prompt) | Eligible SoAI-managed model requests | **Chat configuration > Parameters > SoAI system prompt** |
| Knowledge | Indexed documents for one conversation | **Add attachments > Knowledge** |
| Memory and profile | The signed-in account across chats | **Chat configuration > Memory > Open profile form** |
| Workspace folder | File base for one conversation | **Chat configuration > Files > Change folder** |

**Lock system prompt** carries the same system prompt into new messages and conversations until it is unlocked. **Inherit default** returns a conversation workspace to the account's default folder. A later default-folder change removes an override that falls outside the user's allowed workspace.

##### Watch context occupancy

Open **Chat configuration > Appearance > Input actions**, enable **Token counter**, and select **Save**. The composer counter shows measured or estimated prompt use, including the enabled [SoAI system prompt](#soai-system-prompt), and the selected model's context window when SoAI knows it. Its color changes near the limit. Select it to switch between token occupancy and generation speed.

##### Compact older context

Before an agent request, SoAI can compact older history when the full prompt no longer fits its available budget. To start it yourself, wait until the conversation has a message and is idle, then select **Compact** in the header. SoAI uses the selected conversation model, summarizes older context, and places a visible boundary in the timeline. Later requests use that summary instead of sending every earlier detail word for word.

Expand a boundary to inspect its summary, injected prompt, and statistics. While idle, select **Regenerate** to rebuild a manually created boundary or **Remove boundary** to return the earlier transcript to normal context. Check occupancy before removing one because the restored detail can exceed the model's prompt budget.

##### Messaging conversations compact independently

Automatic compaction also applies to messaging conversations. Each messaging account can set a different context length under the **Settings** button at the right of the header, then **Settings > Messaging > Edit > Chat execution > Edit parameters > Model settings**. Set **Context length (tokens)**, or clear it to use the selected model's default. **A smaller value makes that account compact sooner and does not change other messaging accounts.**

#### Edit and manage conversation history

| Action | History effect |
| --- | --- |
| **Edit** | Replaces a user message, removes later messages, and generates a new continuation. Direct attachments on that message can be removed before saving. |
| **Resend message** | Resubmits that user message and removes all later messages before the new reply. |
| **Regenerate** | Replaces an assistant reply and removes messages after it. |
| **Delete** | Shows a temporary deleted placeholder with an undo period. Selecting Delete again commits immediately. |

**History-changing actions are unavailable during a turn.** Export or clone before rewriting a branch if later turns must be retained.

##### Clone, archive, and delete

Use a conversation row's **Edit** action to rename, recolor, favorite, archive, or export it. Use the sidebar selection toolbar for **Archive selected**, **Clone selected**, or **Delete selected**. **Active or queued work must finish or be cancelled before cloning or deletion.**

A clone receives its own transcript, settings, recorded tool activity, and ready direct-file attachments. Its indexed Knowledge collection is not copied, so Knowledge cards from the source transcript appear unavailable until you add or import those documents again. Archive hides a conversation without deleting it; use **Archived conversations** to find and restore it.

##### Drafts, queues, and reconnection

SoAI saves composer text and ready direct attachments as a conversation draft and synchronizes them between signed-in browsers. If another browser changes the same draft while you are typing, SoAI keeps the local version and reports a conflict. Leaving Chat does not stop accepted work. On reconnection, the page reloads drafts, queued prompts, messages, tool activity, and attention state. Cancel a queued item before it starts; use **Stop** after it begins.

### Voice, dictation, and speech [page: voice-dictation-and-speech]

Chat supports dictation, hands-free voice calls, and text-to-speech playback. These controls depend on browser media support, microphone permission, a secure browser context, and compatible speech models.

#### Prepare speech models and controls

1. Install or configure speech-to-text and text-to-speech models. The bundled [Whisper](https://github.com/openai/whisper) and [Melo TTS](https://github.com/myshell-ai/MeloTTS) plugins provide local paths.
2. In the SoAI WebUI, open **Chat**, open or start a conversation, then select **Chat configuration** in its header.
3. Open **Voice** and choose automatic or specific STT and TTS models.
4. Open **Chat configuration > Appearance > Input actions**, enable **Voice** and **Voice call**, then select **Save**.
5. Open Chat through HTTPS or `localhost` and grant microphone permission when the browser asks.

**Voice Call also requires a selected conversation model.** A model used for STT or TTS does not replace that conversation model.

#### Use speech in Chat

Select **Start voice recording**, speak, then select **Stop recording**. SoAI transcribes the audio with the selected or automatic STT model and inserts the text into the composer. Review it before sending. **Starting dictation ends an active voice call.**

##### Run a voice call

Select **Start voice call**. The call listens until you stop speaking, transcribes the utterance, sends it to the conversation model, and reads the reply through the selected TTS model. If you speak while the assistant is answering, SoAI stops the current speech and response so the new utterance can take over. Use **Pause voice call**, **Resume voice call**, or **End voice call**. Switching conversations ends the call.

##### Read one assistant message aloud

Hover or focus an assistant message and select **Speak**. It uses the same TTS choice configured for voice calls. The action appears only when speech playback applies to that message and the required model is available.

#### When a control is disabled

- Use HTTPS or `localhost`; an insecure origin may not receive microphone access.
- Allow the microphone and confirm that the browser supports media recording.
- Select a conversation model before starting a call.
- Check the configured STT or TTS model and its plugin state.
- Enable the matching action under **Chat configuration > Appearance > Input actions** if the button is absent.

### Attachments and file context [page: attachments-and-file-context]

Chat can upload a managed copy with one message, keep a live reference to an item in the SoAI workspace, or index a collection as Knowledge for retrieval across later prompts. One message can use several of these methods together.

Attachment controls are conditional. On a fresh installation, **Chat** enters the sidebar after the catalog has a selectable conversation model. Appearance settings control the Upload and Scan entry points. Model capabilities control the form of content sent to the provider. See [Chat](#chat) for the first-run model requirement and the wider Chat control visibility table.

Your account needs **Files reading** ([`FILE_EXPLORER_READ`](#acl-FILE_EXPLORER_READ)) for Workspace and SoAI link operations. Knowledge needs **RAG access** ([`RAG_USE`](#acl-RAG_USE)), and **Load from Workspace** needs both. Global Search needs **Internal search access** ([`SEARCH_READ`](#acl-SEARCH_READ)). Its Files results also need **Files reading** ([`FILE_EXPLORER_READ`](#acl-FILE_EXPLORER_READ)) and show only items in your account's workspace. The default policy grants all three actions to Administrator and Standard user accounts. An Administrator with **ACL administration** ([`ACL_ADMIN`](#acl-ACL_ADMIN)) selects the **Settings** button at the right of the header, chooses **Settings**, then opens **ACL** to change them.

#### Choose how to add the source

| Method | What SoAI adds | Use it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Knowledge | A conversation collection that SoAI parses, chunks, embeds, and makes available through the required Knowledge tools. | You expect to ask several questions across one or many documents. |
| Scan | A JPEG photo captured with the browser camera. | You want to show the model a page, object, label, or other physical source. |
| SoAI link | A workspace reference copied from Files, a Files preview, or another supported SoAI surface. | You have already found the source elsewhere in the WebUI. |
| Upload | A managed copy of every selected file, attached to the current user message. | The model needs files for the current prompt and you do not need a searchable collection. |
| Workspace | A live, verified reference to a Files item, or linked reuse of a completed Knowledge source shown in the same search. | The source is already stored in SoAI and should not be uploaded again. |

Direct uploads and scans belong to one message and remain visible in its conversation history. Workspace file and folder references and SoAI links point to stored workspace items; Workspace can also link completed Knowledge from another conversation. **Only Knowledge creates a searchable conversation collection.**

#### Receive files from a messaging app

[Discord](https://discord.com/), [Telegram](https://telegram.org/), and [WhatsApp](https://www.whatsapp.com/) users can send supported files to a messaging account. The server downloads each file, applies the same size limit and processing used for a direct Chat upload, and attaches the result to the matching conversation. The selected model receives the processed attachment with the message text or caption. See [Connect messaging apps to SoAI](#connect-messaging-apps-to-soai) and the provider-specific guides for the file types each app supports.

#### Open the attachment picker

1. Open an existing conversation or start a new one.
2. Select **Add attachments** beside the composer.
3. Choose **Upload**, **Scan**, **Workspace**, **SoAI link**, or **Knowledge**.
4. Add the sources, close the picker, and review the attachment cards above the composer.
5. Wait for direct files and any draft Knowledge attachments to finish processing, then send the message.

If **Add attachments** is not visible, open **Chat configuration**, choose **Appearance**, expand **Input actions**, and enable **Upload file**. The Upload tab follows that setting. The Scan tab follows the **Camera** input action. Workspace, SoAI link, and Knowledge remain enabled whenever the picker is open. A valid SoAI link can also be pasted into the main composer.

##### Controls that appear only when they apply

| Control | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| Add attachments and Upload | Enable **Chat configuration** > **Appearance** > **Input actions** > **Upload file**. This setting is enabled by default. |
| Camera action and Scan | Enable **Camera** in the same Input actions section. It is off by default. Scan also needs camera support and permission from the browser. The Camera composer action can open Scan even when Upload file is off. |
| Flip camera and Capture | These controls become available after the camera stream starts. After capture, they are replaced by **Retake** and **Use photo**. |
| Knowledge Delete | **Delete** appears beside documents that have finished processing, including completed, unreadable, and failed entries. Processing entries remain in the progress list until they finish. |
| Knowledge Reindex | **Reindex** appears after the collection has at least one document. It becomes available after you configure an embedding model. |
| Workspace Preview and Attach | These footer actions appear after you select a Workspace search result. Workspace results also require **Files reading** ([`FILE_EXPLORER_READ`](#acl-FILE_EXPLORER_READ)). |

#### Upload files and folders from your device

In **Add attachments** > **Upload**, select **Upload file** to choose one or more files. Select **Upload folder** to choose a folder, or drop files and folders onto the Upload pane. You can also drag them over an open Chat conversation; when the conversation can accept the drop, SoAI opens the Upload tab for you.

A folder upload expands the folder into separate message attachments, and you can remove any item you do not want before sending. A workspace folder stays a live folder reference, while a Knowledge folder becomes part of an indexed collection.

The picker accepts a broad range of file types instead of enforcing a short MIME list. Each file needs a usable name, at least one byte of content, and a size within the installation's upload limit. A recognized image MIME type or image header enables the visual-image path. Other files, including image-looking files that fail that check, go through document parsing. If no parser extracts useful content, the card can finish as **Reference only**. The selected model still needs the right capabilities to use the result.

Drag and drop works in a conversation that can accept attachments. Conversation selection and blocking dialogs suspend it. To add a local clipboard file or image, use Upload or Scan; composer paste is reserved for text and SoAI links.

#### Attach a Workspace file already stored in SoAI

1. Open **Add attachments** > **Workspace**.
2. If needed, select **Change folder** and choose the Files folder used by this conversation.
3. Enter a name in **Search SoAI files**.
4. Select a result. Use **Preview** to inspect it, or **Attach** to add it to the draft.
5. Repeat the search and selection when you want to add more results.

Workspace search uses the conversation's effective workspace and requires **Files reading** ([`FILE_EXPLORER_READ`](#acl-FILE_EXPLORER_READ)). It can also show completed, reusable Knowledge sources. **A file or folder result becomes a live reference, not another upload.** A Knowledge result instead links its completed items into the current conversation.

##### Start from Global Search or Files

Global Search can find files and documents anywhere you can access in your workspace. Enter at least two characters in the header search and select a file result. The result opens in Files; a folder result opens its location there.

1. In the file preview, select **Attach**. For a folder or several Files items, select them in Files and select **Attach** or **Attach (count)**.
2. SoAI copies one or more SoAI links to the browser clipboard. You choose the target conversation afterward.
3. Open the target conversation and paste the links directly into the main composer, or open **Add attachments** > **SoAI link** and paste them there.
4. SoAI resolves each valid link and adds an attachment card. Review the cards before sending.

This flow works for files, documents, images, audio, video, and folders that your account can read in the workspace. The preview's **Attach** action copies a reference and needs browser clipboard support. Use **Add attachments** > **Workspace** when the item is inside the conversation's current workspace. For an item elsewhere, use **Change folder** to select the workspace that contains it.

##### Paste SoAI links directly into the composer

The normal message field recognizes one or more SoAI links among your text. It resolves the tokens, removes their encoded form from the message, and adds the corresponding attachment cards. The dedicated **SoAI link** tab does the same job when you want a separate field for several copied links.

SoAI links are specific to SoAI workspace items. **A normal web URL or local operating-system path is not a SoAI link and will not become an attachment through this field.**

#### How SoAI protects linked workspace content

The server resolves each link inside the conversation's effective workspace and under the current user's Files permissions. Arbitrary host paths are outside this route. It records the workspace identity and a fingerprint of the target, then verifies both for every request. A changed, moved, missing, retyped, or inaccessible item produces a changed or unavailable notice. **The old card never authorizes different content (even if a replacement uses the same path).**

A linked file can be exposed to the model through enabled file-reading tools when the selected model supports tool calling. Otherwise it attempts to parse and place its content inline. A linked folder can be navigated through enabled file tools; without those tools, the server supplies a bounded folder listing instead. See [File and shell tools](#file-and-shell-tools) for the model-facing workspace tools.

#### Mix several sources in one message

Ordinary uploads, folder-upload files, camera captures, Workspace references, pasted SoAI links, and Knowledge can all coexist in one draft. You can use different methods again later in the conversation. When Knowledge attachments are still pending, running, or cancelling, wait for them to reach a terminal state before submitting the message.

Six attachment cards fit in the inline composer or message strip. The overflow control opens **Message attachments** for the rest, with search and filters for Attachments, Knowledge, and SoAI links. Six is a display limit, not a file-count limit.

**More attachments do not create more model context.** Long extracted text shares a bounded context budget, so adding several large documents can reduce how much text SoAI includes from each one. Ask focused questions, attach only the relevant files, or use Knowledge when the collection is too large for direct inline reading.

#### What reaches the selected model

The provider receives a prepared projection of each attachment. SoAI chooses it from the source type, parser result, selected model capabilities, available tools, and configured limits.

| Source | How SoAI prepares it | What the model receives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Audio | Reads media metadata and attempts local speech transcription. | Transcript and useful metadata. If transcription is unavailable, the result can be degraded or reference-only. |
| Image | Attempts OCR and prepares bounded visual input when the model supports vision. | The image for a vision model; otherwise extracted OCR text when available, or an unavailable notice. |
| Linked folder | Uses enabled file tools when possible; otherwise creates a bounded listing. | A tool-readable relative folder reference or a limited list of entries. |
| PDF, office document, ebook, email, or archive | Runs the matching document parser and stores bounded extracted text. | Parsed text fitted to the request budget. |
| Text, code, and structured data | Reads and labels extracted text as untrusted attachment content. | Text fitted into the request's attachment context budget. Long content can be truncated. |
| Unknown or unreadable file | Keeps the source metadata but records that extraction was unavailable. | A reference notice with the name, media type, and size. |
| Video | Extracts speech and visible text, and samples a bounded set of timestamped still frames. | Transcript and OCR text, plus sampled frames for a vision model. SoAI does not send the raw video as one continuous visual stream. |

##### Images and camera scans

Common image formats can be attached through Upload, Workspace, a SoAI link, or Scan. A vision-capable model receives normalized visual input within the configured pixel and encoded-size limits. OCR text can accompany the image. If visual preparation fails and OCR succeeded, SoAI can still use the extracted text.

**Scan** captures a browser camera frame as a JPEG. **Flip camera** requests the other facing mode on devices that offer one. Select **Capture**, use **Retake** if needed, then select **Use photo**. A vision-capable selected model receives prepared visual input. Other cases use the document and OCR path. Camera support and permission come from the browser and operating system.

##### Video and audio

Video parsing has two separate outputs. SoAI attempts to transcribe the audio track and read visible text from sampled frames. For a vision-capable model, request projection can also include timestamped still frames. The request has one frame allowance for all distinct videos. SoAI starts with the newest videos, assigns one frame to each selected video, then distributes the remaining allowance among them.

Parsing and model input have separate bounds. By default, the parser samples at one frame per second for OCR, up to 360 frames and 250,000 characters of visible text. The later model request can carry no more than 12 sampled visual frames across all videos. With more than 12 distinct videos, only the newest 12 receive a visual frame; the others carry an omission notice. Transcript or OCR text can cover more of a video than the visual frames sent to the model.

Audio parsing reads basic media metadata and attempts speech transcription. Transcription requires the local media parsing dependencies and speech runtime to be available. **A file can finish with a degraded result even though the upload itself succeeded.** For agent-controlled inspection after a chat has started, see [Media reading tools](#media-reading-tools).

##### Documents and other formats

SoAI has parsers for these practical groups:

- plain text, Markdown, source code, logs, and configuration files;
- CSV, JSON, XML, HTML, and Jupyter notebooks;
- PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OpenDocument files;
- EPUB and other supported ebook formats;
- EML, MSG, MBOX, and supported messaging exports;
- ZIP, TAR, and other archives supported by the installed parser stack;
- common image, audio, and video formats.

**Parser availability can depend on installed libraries, and successful extraction does not promise perfect layout, OCR, transcription, spreadsheet formulas, or archive coverage.** The Upload picker may accept a format that later becomes reference-only. For parser internals, chunking, OCR, and indexed ingestion, use [Knowledge and document collections (RAG)](#knowledge-and-document-collections-rag) instead of treating direct attachments as RAG.

#### Processing states and sending

| What you see | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Processing... | SoAI is storing, identifying, and parsing the direct file. | Wait for processing to finish. If it fails, remove the failed card before sending. |
| Ready | Processing finished and SoAI can include the attachment record in a message. | Check for a Reference only or Text truncated suffix, then send when the rest of the draft is ready. |
| Ready - Reference only | The upload is valid, but SoAI did not extract usable content for inline reading. | Use a supported format, enable suitable file tools for a workspace reference, or describe what you need. |
| Ready - Text truncated | SoAI extracted text but had to keep or project only a bounded portion. | Attach a smaller source, ask a narrower question, split the file, or use Knowledge. |
| Failed to process | Storage or parsing did not complete. | Remove the failed card before sending, then retry the file or use another format. |
| Unavailable after sending | A transcript card or request-time notice says that a linked source no longer matches, no longer exists, or is no longer accessible. | Find the current workspace item and attach it again. |

Removing an unsent direct attachment cancels its remaining processing and removes its managed storage when safe. After a message is sent, its cards remain part of the transcript. Available cards can expose preview, open, or download actions according to the source and your access.

#### Current default limits

These values are the shipped defaults. To change one in the SoAI WebUI, an Administrator with **Configuration changes** ([`CONFIG_PATCH`](#acl-CONFIG_PATCH)) selects the **Settings** button at the right of the header, then **Settings** and the page-header **Advanced** toggle. Select the generated configuration tab containing the named setting, edit it, and select the page-header **Save** control. The Advanced toggle is hidden unless both requirements are met. The WebUI reads the effective direct-upload limit from the server.

| Limit | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Attachment cards shown inline | 6 | A display limit only. Use **Message attachments** for the rest. |
| Audio and video parse time | 21,600 seconds | Processing stops at this deadline; normal parsing can finish much sooner. See [`TOOLS.MEDIA_PARSING.PARSE_TIMEOUT_SEC`](#config-TOOLS.MEDIA_PARSING.PARSE_TIMEOUT_SEC). |
| Direct file size | 250 MiB per file | [`API.OPENAI.MAX_FILE_UPLOAD_MB`](#config-API.OPENAI.MAX_FILE_UPLOAD_MB) |
| Fallback linked-folder listing | 20 entries and 12,000 characters | [`SERVER.WEBUI.SOAI_LINKS.PROJECTION_FOLDER_MAX_ENTRIES`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.SOAI_LINKS.PROJECTION_FOLDER_MAX_ENTRIES) and [`SERVER.WEBUI.SOAI_LINKS.PROJECTION_FOLDER_MAX_CHARS`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.SOAI_LINKS.PROJECTION_FOLDER_MAX_CHARS) |
| Image visual projection | 128 MiB source, 4,000,000 pixels, 16,777,216 encoded characters | Larger images can upload within the direct file limit but cannot be projected visually without fitting these limits. See [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_IMAGE.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_IMAGE.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES), [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_IMAGE.MAX_PIXELS`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_IMAGE.MAX_PIXELS), and [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_IMAGE.MAX_ENCODED_CHARS`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_IMAGE.MAX_ENCODED_CHARS). |
| Inline extracted text stored per source | 2,000,000 characters | [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_TEXT.MAX_STORE_CHARS`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_TEXT.MAX_STORE_CHARS) |
| Inline text share of model context | 30%, after reserving 2,048 output tokens | The computed budget is divided among inline text attachments. See [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_TEXT.CONTEXT_FRACTION`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_TEXT.CONTEXT_FRACTION). |
| Non-media document parse time | 120 seconds per direct upload | [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_TEXT.UPLOAD_PARSE_TIMEOUT_SEC`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_TEXT.UPLOAD_PARSE_TIMEOUT_SEC) |
| Reusable Knowledge selection | Up to 100 completed items from one source per attach operation | A reusable source with more completed items is rejected. See [`SERVER.WEBUI.KNOWLEDGE_LINKS.USE_MAX_ITEMS`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.KNOWLEDGE_LINKS.USE_MAX_ITEMS) |
| SoAI links in one resolve operation | 64 tokens, 32 distinct paths | [`SERVER.WEBUI.SOAI_LINKS.RESOLVE_MAX_TOKENS`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.SOAI_LINKS.RESOLVE_MAX_TOKENS) and [`SERVER.WEBUI.SOAI_LINKS.RESOLVE_MAX_DISTINCT_PATHS`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.SOAI_LINKS.RESOLVE_MAX_DISTINCT_PATHS) |
| Video frames per request | 12 frames, 16,777,216 encoded characters, and a 120-second projection deadline | [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_VIDEO.MAX_FRAMES_PER_REQUEST`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_VIDEO.MAX_FRAMES_PER_REQUEST), [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_VIDEO.MAX_ENCODED_CHARS_PER_REQUEST`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_VIDEO.MAX_ENCODED_CHARS_PER_REQUEST), and [`SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_VIDEO.PROJECTION_TIMEOUT_SEC`](#config-SERVER.WEBUI.PROVIDER_VIDEO.PROJECTION_TIMEOUT_SEC) |
| Video OCR during parsing | 1 frame per second, up to 360 frames and 250,000 extracted characters | [`TOOLS.MEDIA_PARSING.VIDEO_OCR_FRAMES_PER_SECOND`](#config-TOOLS.MEDIA_PARSING.VIDEO_OCR_FRAMES_PER_SECOND), [`TOOLS.MEDIA_PARSING.VIDEO_OCR_MAX_FRAMES`](#config-TOOLS.MEDIA_PARSING.VIDEO_OCR_MAX_FRAMES), and [`TOOLS.MEDIA_PARSING.VIDEO_OCR_MAX_TEXT_CHARS`](#config-TOOLS.MEDIA_PARSING.VIDEO_OCR_MAX_TEXT_CHARS) |
| Workspace search results | Up to 20 workspace and 20 reusable Knowledge results per search | Refine **Search SoAI files** when the target is not in the result table. |

Ordinary direct attachments have no separate fixed count. Per-file size, processing resources, request size, model context, provider capability, and administrator settings still bound a practical request.

#### Use Knowledge for a searchable collection

Use **Add attachments** > **Knowledge** for a collection that must remain searchable. This requires **RAG access** ([`RAG_USE`](#acl-RAG_USE)). Upload files or a folder, or select **Load from Workspace**. In the **Import folder** prompt, enter a Files path such as `/path/to/folder`. SoAI queues a recursive import. The items are searchable only after parsing, chunking, and embedding complete.

**Knowledge requires an embedding model.** Open [Models catalog](#models-catalog) to download one or follow its External provider setup to connect an OpenAI-compatible embedding provider. [Bundled plugins reference](#bundled-plugins-reference) describes the local Embedding and External plugin capabilities. The conversation model also needs tool-calling support to search Knowledge while answering. **Auto (embedding)** selects from embedding models already available in the catalog. Download or connect the model first; Auto neither downloads a model nor changes a chat model's capabilities.

Retrieval also requires **Enable RAG** under **Chat configuration** > **Knowledge** and the required Knowledge tools to be available. When the collection and model are ready, SoAI keeps those tools enabled for the conversation.

**Load from Workspace** ingests files into the collection. Attaching a Workspace file or folder keeps a live reference instead. Completed reusable Knowledge sources can appear in Workspace search for another conversation owned by the current user, subject to the installation's item limit.

Knowledge controls are also conditional. **Reindex** appears once the collection has documents and is enabled only when an embedding model is configured. For the full WebUI setup, retrieval settings, parser behavior, and indexing lifecycle, see the Knowledge section in [Chat](#chat) and the technical [Knowledge and document collections (RAG)](#knowledge-and-document-collections-rag) page.

#### Troubleshooting

| What you see | Likely reason | Next step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A Global Search result did not appear in Chat | Search opens Files or its preview; it does not choose a target conversation. | Select **Attach** in the preview, then paste the copied SoAI link into the target chat. |
| A SoAI link is unavailable | The workspace, target fingerprint, file type, path, or permission changed. | Find the current item in Files or Workspace search and attach it again. |
| Add attachments is missing | The Upload file input action is hidden in this conversation's Appearance settings. | Enable **Chat configuration** > **Appearance** > **Input actions** > **Upload file**. |
| Chat is missing from the sidebar | No selectable conversation model has unlocked Chat in this browser. | Open [Models catalog](#models-catalog) and download or add a chat-capable model that is loaded or available. |
| Knowledge stays unsearchable | Indexing is incomplete, RAG is off, the Knowledge tools are unavailable, no embedding model is available, or the conversation model lacks tool calling. | Enable RAG, finish embedding, and wait for completion. Then verify the Knowledge tools and the conversation model's tool-calling capability. |
| Scan is unavailable | Camera is hidden, unsupported, blocked, or has no permission. | Enable the Camera input action, use HTTPS or `localhost`, and allow camera access in the browser. |
| The model cannot interpret an image or video | The selected model lacks vision, the catalog capability is wrong, or OCR and transcription found too little. | Choose a verified vision model in [Models catalog](#models-catalog), or provide a text description. |
